title: Consistent bidirectional adjacency
statement: The system shall make every committed edge traversable from both its source node and its target node, with 0 one-sided edges visible on voting replicas.
rationale: Edges are stored as an out-entry under the source and an in-entry under the target; both must be written in the same transaction.

acceptance_criteria.text: For any committed edge, MATCH (a)-[e]->(b) from a and MATCH (b)<-[e]-(a) from b both return e with identical properties.
The Jepsen-style suite with concurrent edge inserts, updates and deletes across shards finds 0 edges visible from only one endpoint on voting replicas.
